title: Basic Input/Output
prompt:
Write a program that prompts the user to enter their name and then prints out a greeting message with the name. Print the greeting message to the console.
Sample Input: John
Sample Output: Hello, John!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a simple Python program that prompts the user to enter their name and then prints out a greeting message with the name:
```python
# Prompt the user to enter their name
name = input("Please enter your name: ")

# Print a greeting message with the user's name
print(f"Hello, {name}!")
```
When you run this program and enter your name (e.g., "John"), the output will be:
```
Please enter your name: John
Hello, John!
```
I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions.
